powerball.sourceText: How to PlayEach play costs $3. Pick five numbers between 1 and 69. Pick one Powerball number between 1 and 26. If you'd like random numbers, ask for a quick pick. Multi-draw tickets can be produced for up to 15 consecutive draws. Drawings are Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. The PowerPlay option is automatically included in every Powerball purchase. PowerPlay for Powerball is a way to multiply your prize of $50,000 or less by 2, 3, 4, 5, or even 10 times. IMPORTANT: The 10 times multiplier is ONLY in play when the advertised annuity jackpot is $150 million or I less. The Match 5 prize with PowerPlay is always $2,000,000. If you match all the numbers you win the jackpot! NEW DOUBLE PLAY FEATURE: For an extra $1 per play your numbers will go into a second drawing to win even more prizes – up to $10 MILLION! The Double Play drawing will be held immediately after the regular Powerball drawings. The starting annuitized prize for Powerball is $20 Million.Powerball tickets cannot be canceled after they are processed. Responsibility for the numbers selected rests with the player, not the retailer or the Lottery.MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.Payment: You have 60 days after you claim the jackpot to determine if you want the cash or the annuity option. The Jackpot Prize is paid as an annuity of 30 payments over 29 years or, at the election of the winner, in a lump sum payment of the cash value of the annuity prize. If the winner chooses the annuity, the annual payments will be increased each year by a percentage set out in the Powerball game rules. The jackpot is pari-mutuel. You win other cash prizes when you correctly match other Powerball numbers drawn. Prizes must be claimed within 180 days from the date of the drawing. All prizes for Powerball must be claimed in the state where the ticket was purchased.
limitations: Source prose says the 10x threshold is $150 million or less; the schedule footnote says under $150 million. Preserve both statements without resolving the boundary.

mega-millions.sourceText: How to PlayEach play costs $5 and will automatically include a unique multiplier that will print directly on the ticket. This will multiply your non-jackpot prize by 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10 for no extra cost. Pick five numbers between 1 and 70. Pick one Mega Ball number between 1 and 24. If you’d like random numbers, ask for a quick pick. Multi-draw tickets can be produced for up to 10 consecutive draws. Drawings are Tuesday and Friday at 9:00 pm MT. The starting annuitized prize for Mega Millions is $50 Million.The overall odds of winning a prize in this game are 1:23Mega Millions tickets cannot be canceled after they are processed. Responsibility for the numbers selected rests with the player, not the retailer or the Lottery.MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.Payment: You have 60 days after you claim the jackpot to determine if you want cash or the annuity option. If you choose the annuity option you will receive your prize over 30 payments. The jackpot is pari-mutuel. You win other cash prizes when you correctly match other Mega Millions numbers drawn. Prizes must be claimed within 180 days from the date of the drawing. All prizes for Mega Millions must be claimed in the state where the ticket was purchased.
limitations: The schedule retains the legacy Megaplier heading. Current rule prose specifies a unique multiplier printed on each ticket, included in the $5 play.

lotto-america.sourceText: How to PlayEach play costs $1. Pick five numbers from 1 to 52. Then pick one Star Ball number from 1 to 10. For an extra $1 per play, you can add the All-Star Bonus to multiply your non-jackpot prizes by 2, 3, 4, or 5 times their original prize. If you’d like the computer to select your numbers, ask for a quick pick. Multi-draw tickets can be produced for up to 15 consecutive draws. Drawings are Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 8:15 pm MT. The rolling jackpot starts at $2 MILLION!Overall odds of winning a prize are 1:9.6Lotto America tickets cannot be canceled after they are processed. Responsibility for the numbers selected rests with the player, not the retailer or the Lottery.MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.Payment: The jackpot will be divided equally among multiple winners. You can win other cash prizes when you match at least the Star Ball number or 3 white balls. Prizes must be claimed within 180 days from the date of the drawing. All prizes for Lotto America must be claimed in the state where the ticket was purchased.

idaho-cash.sourceText: How to PlayGet two plays for $1. Pick five numbers from 1 to 45. If you’d like the computer to select your numbers, ask for a quick pick. Multi-draw tickets can be produced for up to 35 consecutive draws. Drawings are daily at 8:00 pm MT. This game is only played in Idaho! Rolling jackpot starts at $20,000!Overall odds of winning a prize are 1:5.7Idaho Cash tickets cannot be canceled after they are processed. Responsibility for the numbers selected rests with the player, not the retailer or the Lottery.MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.Free ticket will be a quick pick.Payment: If the Jackpot is not won, prize funds will be added to the next drawing’s Jackpot prize. *The Jackpot prize will be divided equally among multiple winners. The Jackpot prize is paid in one lump-sum, cash payment.

millionaire-for-life.sourceText: How To PlayDecide how many plays you want. Each play costs $5. For each play, pick any five numbers from 1 to 58. Then pick another number from 1 to 5. If you want the computer to randomly select your numbers, ask the retailer for a "Quick Pick" or mark the QP box for each play on the playslip. If you want to play the same numbers for up to thirty-five consecutive draws, mark the appropriate number of drawings in the "Multi-Draw" section. Drawings are held daily at 9:20 pm MT. MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.Payment: The top two prizes are offered as a lifetime annuity payment, or as a lump sum cash payment. Players will make an irrevocable choice of an annuity, or a lump sum cash payment when claiming their prize. Match 5 + 1 prize will be an annuity prize of $1,000,000 a year for life (or the cash value of $18,000,000 in a one-time lump sum cash payment) Match 5 + 0 prize will be an annuity prize of $100,000 a year for life (or the cash value of $2,200,000 in a one-time lump sum cash payment) Prizes must be claimed within 180 days from the date of the drawing. All prizes for Millionaire for Life must be claimed in the state where the ticket was purchased.

pick-3.sourceText: How to PlayWagers for Pick 3 start at $1. Pick your favorite three-digit number. If you’d like random numbers, ask for a quick pick. Choose your wager type and amount you want to wager. Wager types include: Exact Order, Any Order (4-way, 6-way), Exact/Any Order (4-way, 6-way), Front Pair, or Back Pair.For an extra $1 per dollar wagered, you can add Sum it up! If the sum of your Pick 3 numbers is the same as the sum of the three single-digit numbers drawn, you win. For example, if you play the Sum it up! feature and your Pick 3 numbers are 1-2-3, the sum of your numbers is 6. If the sum of the three numbers drawn also equals 6 (whether they match your numbers or not), then you win! Multi-draw tickets can be produced for up to 70 consecutive draws. Drawings are day and night, every day at 1:59 at 7:59 pm MT. This game is only played in Idaho! Sum it up! cannot be used with front or back pair wager type. Pick 3 tickets cannot be canceled after they are processed. Responsibility for the numbers selected rests with the player, not the retailer or the Lottery. Wager Type Descriptions:Exact Order: Numbers drawn match your numbers in exact order.Any Order 3-way: Numbers drawn match your numbers in any order (3 numbers the same).Any Order 6-way: Numbers drawn match your numbers in any order (2 numbers the same).Exact/Any Order 3-way: All 3 numbers in exact/any order (3 numbers the same).Exact/Any Order 6-way: All 3 numbers in exact/any order (2 numbers the same).Front Pair: First 2 numbers in exact order (pick 2 numbers only).Back Pair: Last 2 numbers in exact order (pick 2 numbers only).MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.
limitations: Source introduction lists 4-way while the schedule lists 3-way. Source 3-way/6-way descriptions also contain inconsistent repeated-digit examples. Preserve literal source text; do not use these descriptions to compute matches or winner counts.
Source drawing-time prose contains the wording 1:59 at 7:59 pm MT; do not infer a corrected cutoff.

pick-4.sourceText: How to PlayWagers for Pick 4 start at $1. Pick your favorite four-digit number. If you’d like random numbers, ask for a quick pick. Choose your wager type and amount you want to wager. Wager types include: Exact Order, Any Order (4-way, 6-way, 12-way or 24-way), Exact/Any Order (4-way, 6-way, 12-way, or 24-way), Front Pair, Mid Pair or Back Pair.For an extra $1 per dollar wagered, you can add Sum it up! If the sum of your Pick 4 numbers is the same as the sum of the four single-digit numbers drawn, you win. For example, if you play the Sum it up! feature and your Pick 4 numbers are 1-2-3-4, the sum of your numbers is 10. If the sum of the four numbers drawn also equals 10 (whether they match your numbers or not), then you win! Multi-draw tickets can be produced for up to 70 consecutive draws. Drawings are day and night, every day at 1:59 at 7:59 pm MT. This game is only played in Idaho! Sum it up! cannot be used with front, mid or back pair wager type. Pick 4 tickets cannot be canceled after they are processed. Responsibility for the numbers selected rests with the player, not the retailer or the Lottery.Wager Type Descriptions:Exact Order: Numbers drawn match your numbers in exact order.Any Order 4-way: Numbers drawn match your numbers in any order (3 numbers the same).Any Order 6-way: Numbers drawn match your numbers in any order (2 pairs of the same numbers).Any Order 12-way: Numbers drawn match your numbers in any order (2 numbers the same).Any Order 24-way: Numbers drawn match your numbers in any order (4 unique numbers).Exact/Any Order 4-way: All 4 numbers in exact/any order (3 numbers the same).Exact/Any Order 6-way: All 4 numbers in exact/any order (2 pairs of the same numbers).Exact/Any Order 12-way: All 4 numbers in exact/any order (2 numbers the same).Exact/Any Order 24-way: All 4 numbers in exact/any order (4 unique numbers).Front Pair: First 2 numbers in exact order (pick 2 numbers only).Mid Pair: Middle 2 numbers in exact order (pick 2 numbers only).Back Pair: Last 2 numbers in exact order (pick 2 numbers only). MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.
limitations: Source drawing-time prose contains the wording 1:59 at 7:59 pm MT; do not infer a corrected cutoff.

powerball-xs-os.sourceText: How To PlayEach play cost $5. For each play, pick eight (8) NFL team logos out of 32. Fill in the circle next to the team logo. If you select fewer than 8 team logos, the remaining teams will be selected for you. If you want the computer to randomly select your teams, ask the retailer for a "Quick Pick" or mark the QP box on the playslip. If you want to play the same eight NFL teams for up to five (5) consecutive draws, mark the appropriate number of drawings in the Multi-Draw section. Drawings are held every Sunday at 8:00 p.m. MT.NOTE: This is a lottery game, not sports betting.Powerball Xs & Os results are randomly drawn and not based on, determined by, or dependent on the outcome of NFL games. The overall odds of winning a prize in this game are 1:12. The Jackpot starts at $1,000,000. In cases of multiple prize winners, prize amounts will be split.MAKE SURE TO SIGN YOUR TICKET PRIOR TO PRESENTING FOR PAYMENT.Payment: You have 60 days after you claim the jackpot to determine if you want the cash or the annuity option. The Jackpot Prize is paid as an annuity of 30 payments over 29 years or, at the election of the winner, in a lump sum payment of the cash value of the annuity prize. If the winner chooses the annuity, the annual payments will be increased each year by a percentage set out in the Powerball game rules. If more than one player has a validated ticket matching the winning logos, the jackpot prize will be a parimutuel payout, determined by dividing the funds available for the Jackpot Prize by the number of Jackpot winning Plays. Lower-Tier, or set prizes are not a parimutuel payout unless liability limits are reached.
limitations: General source prose says prize amounts will be split for multiple winners; payment prose qualifies lower-tier prizes as non-parimutuel unless liability limits are reached. Preserve the full qualification.
